record_kind: independent AI linguistic and static consumer review; bounded whole-value decisions, not native-human or runtime acceptance

binding_verification.method: Executed and inspected packet verify_candidates.py against supplied pinned implementation. It recomputed SHA-256, byte size and Git blob SHA-1 for 325 source/inventory bindings; verified every pair, DOM attributes, placeholders, 118 existing terms and exact consumer windows across all four candidate groups.
binding_verification.source_commit_authentication_limit: This verifies supplied bytes against the commit-labelled packet bindings; this reviewer did not independently fetch remote Git commit/tree objects.

global_qualifications: All decisions are independent static whole-string judgments, not adoption of author confidence.
No source, candidate packet, repository, remote service or application was changed. Only this review output and a temporary output-generation script were written.
No native-human, device, layout, compiled resource, runtime, legal or whole-locale acceptance is asserted.
All original 118 terms remain untouched; the existing 110 are context, not newly accepted here.
No P1 expansion. Save/share action labels do not alter the current document Save target, dirty-state behavior or untranslated adjacent actions.
PR56 never-merge, PR159 freeze, PR113 held/retarget work, Help callback/archive identity and release pause are not changed.
lexical_reference_limits: These primary Nynorsk usage references corroborate the attribution sense only; acceptance of biletkrediteringane and the complete messages is the reviewer’s contextual inference, not a dictionary-derived or native-human approval.

lexical_references.support: Primary Nynorsk explanation uses kreditering for identifying source, institution and licence, supporting a broader attribution sense rather than finance or author names alone.
Primary Nynorsk educational text uses kreditering in attribution/licensing context; lexical corroboration only, not legal advice.

entries.source: The image credits could not be saved or restored. Existing saved credits have been kept. Try again.
entries.candidate: Biletkrediteringane kunne ikkje lagrast eller gjenopprettast. Krediteringar som alt var lagra, er tekne vare på. Prøv på nytt.
entries.exact_final_target: Biletkrediteringane kunne ikkje lagrast eller gjenopprettast. Krediteringar som alt var lagra, er tekne vare på. Prøv på nytt.
entries.attribute_and_placeholder_review: pass; no added/dropped token, precision, index or attribute
entries.rationale: The complete message preserves failure to save OR restore, retention of already saved credits, and a retry instruction. Biletkrediteringane is an intelligible attribution compound in this image context, not monetary credit. Krediteringar som alt var lagra and er tekne vare på distinguish retained previous data from an unsuccessful new edit. All 14 windows were checked, including restore/open failures, rejected late or mismatched session results, editor construction, save/dismiss and lifecycle draft persistence. GalleryCredits.credit constructs source/licence/publisher/author/free-form text, and the translation does not narrow that content to only author names.
qualifications: The attribution sense is a contextual whole-message judgment. Primary Nynorsk usage corroborates kreditering for source attribution but does not certify this UI compound or runtime data durability.

entries.exact_final_target: Desse biletkrediteringane ville gjera teikninga for stor til å gjenoppretta. Den førre teikninga og krediteringane er tekne vare på.
entries.attribute_and_placeholder_review: pass; no added/dropped token, precision, index or attribute
entries.rationale: Desse biletkrediteringane ville gjera teikninga for stor til å gjenoppretta retains the hypothetical restoration-size admission failure; no pixel dimensions or file-format restriction is introduced. The second sentence explicitly retains the previous drawing and credits, not the attempted replacement. The three consumers reject metadata/history or inline-text admission before successful adoption.
qualifications: The previous drawing means the retained state, not a promise that all historical versions can be restored. No runtime fault-injection or all-path transactional guarantee is claimed.

entries.attribute_and_placeholder_review: pass; no added/dropped token, precision, index or attribute
entries.rationale: The full value separates completed image saving (Biletet vart lagra) from the subsequent Android sharing-launch failure (men Android kunne ikkje starta deling). The colon and %1$s exception token are exact. In writeImage, outputStream copying completes before shareSavedImage is called; that method catches FileProvider/chooser launch exceptions. The translation does not erase the successful write or wrongly report that sharing itself completed.
qualifications: The saved object in this flow is a copy. Because export=true bypasses savedTarget assignment and markSaved, this is not a claim that the working drawing has become saved. No Android device chooser test was performed; exception detail can remain untranslated.
